summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi CAMT 2x Daily ETF (CAMC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Camtek Ltd. (NASDAQ: CAMT), which manufactures automated inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. CAMC was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
